name: Affiliate Disclosure – Auto Customizable Affiliate Links Disclaimer
author: dragoncodewp

sections.description:
Add Affiliate Disclosure allows you to easily display an FTC-compliant affiliate disclosure notice on your WordPress posts. Ensure transparency with your audience and stay compliant with affiliate program requirements (like Amazon Associates) by automatically inserting a customizable notice.

Key Features

  • Automatic Placement: Automatically inserts the disclosure before your post content.
  • Customizable Text: Write your own disclosure message using the rich text editor.
  • Gradient & Styles: Choose from variety of beautiful gradient presets, or use Minimal/Flat styles to match your theme.
  • Live Preview: See exactly how your notice will look in the settings page before saving.
  • Targeting: Show the notice globally, or target specific categories (or exclude them).
  • Position Control: Place the notice at the top, bottom, or after a specific paragraph.
  • Shortcode Support: Use [affiliate_disclosure_notice] to place the disclosure manually anywhere in your content.
  • Mobile Responsive: Looks great on all devices.
  • Checkmark Icon: Option to add a trust checkmark icon.

Pro Features (Freemius)

This plugin offers a Premium version via Freemius which unlocks:
* Custom Colors: Define your own brand colors for the gradient.
* Premium Gradients: Access to the full library of 18+ gradients.
* Dismissible Notices: Allow users to dismiss the notice for 3, 7, or 30 days.
* Dismissal Checkmark: Persistent checkmark state.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the affiliate-disclosure-notice folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Affiliate Notice to configure your disclosure.
sections.faq:
Can I change the text?

Yes! You can fully customize the disclosure text using the standard WordPress editor in the settings.

Does this work with Amazon Associates?

Yes, this plugin is designed to help you meet the requirement of having a clear and conspicuous disclosure.

How do I use the shortcode?

Simply add [affiliate_disclosure_notice] to any post, page, or widget. You can also customize it directly via attributes:
[affiliate_disclosure_notice style=”minimal” text=”My custom disclosure”]
